programs.title: House Hunters International
programs.desc: A fun-loving couple, along with their new baby and two rescue dogs, search for a better quality of life in Logrono, Spain. They're looking for something with Spanish charm, but finding a place that meets everything on their wish list will be a challenge.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: As their three daughters get older, Georgia residents Lisa and Kevin are looking for a change of pace from their busy lives. They want to move to a place their kids will always want to return to, and they've set their sights on Hilton Head, South Carolina.

programs.title: House Hunters
programs.desc: Tired of a studio apartment in Boston, a young couple is moving to Palm Beach Gardens, Florida, to be closer to family, and to enjoy a more laid-back life; she wants a home with no hassles that's move-in ready; he'd rather do some projects.

programs.title: Home Town Takeover
programs.desc: Ben and Erin, with the help of Jasmine Roth and Chef Mika Leon, elevate a family-owned restaurant; they also surprise a generous couple who helps veterans with a home renovation.

programs.title: Good Bones
programs.desc: A mother has called on Mina and Karen to help fix up a home that she purchased for her daughter. While the cottage is in better condition than most of their projects, they want to add more living space and straighten its crooked exterior.

programs.title: Fix My Frankenhouse
programs.desc: After years of long-distance commuting, a couple finally settles down in Rehoboth, Mass., but the layout of their spacious home is confusing; Mike looks to bring cohesion back to the home, while Denese creates a kitchen fit for an actual chef.

programs.title: The Flipping El Moussas
programs.desc: It's a full-circle moment for Heather as she and Tarek head to her hometown to do a flip in Big Bear, California, where Tarek is pushed out of his comfort zone with some bold designs and a debate on whether to sell the cabin or keep it as a rental.
